targets.rawSql: SELECT city AS name, latitude, longitude, temperature_c, weather_description, humidity_pct FROM v_weather_latest

SELECT city AS "Ville", country AS "Pays", temperature_c AS "Temp (°C)", feels_like_c AS "Ressenti", humidity_pct AS "Hum (%)", wind_speed_kmh AS "Vent (km/h)", wind_direction AS "Dir.", weather_description AS "Conditions", CASE WHEN alert_count > 0 THEN '🚨 ' || alert_count ELSE '✅' END AS "Alertes" FROM v_weather_latest ORDER BY country, city
SELECT fetched_at AS time, temperature_c AS "Température", feels_like_c AS "Ressenti" FROM weather_events WHERE city = 'Paris' AND $__timeFilter(fetched_at) ORDER BY fetched_at

SELECT fetched_at AS time, precip_mm AS "Pluie (mm)", wind_speed_kmh AS "Vent (km/h)", wind_gusts_kmh AS "Rafales (km/h)" FROM weather_events WHERE city = 'Paris' AND $__timeFilter(fetched_at) ORDER BY fetched_at
SELECT city AS metric, temperature_c AS value FROM v_weather_latest ORDER BY temperature_c DESC
SELECT NOW() as time, COUNT(*) as value FROM v_weather_latest WHERE alert_count > 0
SELECT city AS "Ville", alerts_json AS "Alertes", alert_count AS "Nb" FROM v_weather_latest WHERE alert_count > 0 ORDER BY alert_count DESC
